newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia SBI up, fuelled by rise in Lek.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia SBI up, fuelled by rise in Lek.

text.p: Slovenian SBI share index rose on Thursday, pulled up by an almost three percent jump in market heavyweight drug maker Lek.

"The same buyers (foreigners), as last week resumed their activity which was expected after they withdrew for a few days in order to push prices lower. I expect shares to oscillate over next week," said Robert Rudolf, a trader at brokers Moja delnica.
* The SBI blue-chip rose 1.85 percent or 26.05 points to 1,431.02.
* Lek, rose 2.84 percent to 32,930 tolars on volume of 7,262 shares.
* Dolenjska bank preferred shares were the top gainers, jumping 3.08 percent to 13,400 tolars on volume of 30 shares.
